about: The PK Reference server's insights for the fixture event (limitless/event-83: M-C, 83 players, 2026-10-05), as MetaService works them out at 2026-10-06T12:00:00Z in the 30-day window. Recorded by the backend's MetaGoldenFileTest, which checks it; the app's version worked out on the device checks against it too, so the two give the same numbers. "event" has the event alone. "trends" adds a copy of its first 60 teams dated 2026-09-15 (three weeks earlier), so both fortnights have 50 teams or more. Items, abilities, natures and moves are standardized by NameStandardizer; species keys are the app's (golden/species-identity.json). Shares are 0 to 1, rounded to 4 places; lists are cut to the server's lengths (12 values, 10 sets, 20 cores).
